statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail). The returned vector has length n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] is the minimum of the prefix cost[0..i]: (a) r[i] <= cost[j] for every j with 0 <= j <= i, and (b) there exists j with 0 <= j <= i such that r[i] = cost[j].
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100. All values are 64-bit signed integers and these bounds are within range.

statement: The function returns a result r; in particular it does not fail, panic, overflow, or go out of bounds on any input satisfying the constraints.
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, len(r) = n = len(cost).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, r[i] >= r[i+1].
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r[0] = cost[0], and for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, r[i+1] = min(r[i], cost[i+1]), where min denotes the smaller of the two i64 values.
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if cost[0] <= cost[j] for every j with 0 <= j < n, then r[i] = cost[0] for every i with 0 <= i < n.
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if there is an index k with 0 <= k < n such that cost[k] < cost[j] for every j with 0 <= j < n and j != k, then for every i with k <= i < n, r[i] = cost[k].
preconditions: len(cost) = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100.

statement: For any valid cost array cost' of the same length n and any i with 0 <= i < n, whenever min_costs(cost) returns r and min_costs(cost') returns r', if cost[j] = cost'[j] for every j with 0 <= j <= i, then r[i] = r'[i].
preconditions: Both cost and cost' are valid inputs: len(cost) = len(cost') = n with 1 <= n <= 100, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= cost[i] <= 100 and 1 <= cost'[i] <= 100.
